models.title: WNV-R0
models.description: WNV-R0 estimates a relative version of the basic reproduction number (R₀)  for WNV transmission by Culex pipiens using ambient temperature data.  The model is intended for seasonal and regional temperature suitability  assessments rather than real-time forecasting of WNV outbreaks.
